newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cityhold sells four firms for 7.5 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Cityhold sells four firms for 7.5 mln rand.

text.p: South Africa's City Investment Holdings (Cityhold) said on Thursday it had disposed of four companies for a total cash consideration of 7.5 million rand with effect from April 1.
Cityhold said in a statement that it had sold Highland Engineering, Industrial Fabrications, Vaalclad and Vaal Mac Engineering to Davide Parodi.

The firms were part of a number of acquisitions made by Cityhold and parent Spicer-Mitchell Holdings Ltd over the past four years. Cityhold said these had been "sifted through" and the parts that did not fit sold off.
Cityhold said that the disposals were also influenced by prevailing business conditions, which contributed towards the loss reported by the group for the 15 months to end December.
The sale would be paid for in four tranches, two of three million rand each at May 31 and July 9 and two of 750,000 rand each at July 31 and August 31.
Cityhold said the deal would contribute towards bringing down the group's gearing and financing future growth opportunities.
Following the disposals the group's profile now comprised three sectors, namely aluminium profiles and products, plumbware and tiles and industrial manufacturing, it said.
